quotes: Travel isn’t always pretty. It isn’t always comfortable. Sometimes it hurts, it even breaks your heart. But that’s okay. The journey changes you.
If I’m an advocate for anything, it’s to move. As far as you can, as much as you can. Across the ocean, or simply across the river.
We ask very simple questions: What makes us laugh? What makes us cry? What makes us feel?

quotes: Maybe that’s enlightenment enough: to know that there is no final resting place of the mind; no moment of smug clarity.
It’s an irritating reality that many places and events in our lives — even whole eras — are somewhat absurd, and almost meaningless.
The journey is part of the experience — an expression of the seriousness of one’s intent to know the world.
